site.title: KYRI Training — Personal training & conditioning
site.description: Personal training with Kyriakos Nicolaou: strength, conditioning and cardio for fighters and for everyone who wants to get fit. Book your sessions online.
site.coachManifestDescription: Kyri's coach dashboard: athletes, bookings and billing.
site.heroLead: 1-on-1 personal training and small-group sessions with Kyriakos Nicolaou. Fighters from every martial art come to him for their conditioning. Everyone else comes for the cardio, strength and fat loss. Same coach, same standard, a plan built around your goal.
site.coachBio: Personal trainer specialising in strength and conditioning. Kyri builds the engine: fighters from Muay Thai, boxing, MMA and more train with him to get through every round, and non-fighters train with him to get fitter, stronger and leaner. Every session is planned around your goal.
